findings.problem: KeyboardOnly removes FOCUSED from live flags when focus came from a pointer, then publishes bindings with those style-adjusted flags. Ui::publish_bindings_filtered requires FOCUSED, so the pointer-focused control has no Enter/Space action binding until focus visibility changes and a frame is republished.
findings.reproduction: Real Harness with OTHER and BUTTON, KeyboardOnly. Mouse Down(10,0), Up(10,0): BUTTON is focused, runtime focus_visible=false, activations=1. First Enter leaves activations=1 instead of2. The original seven tests pass but never test this no-Tab sequence.
findings.repair: Publish keyboard bindings using actual interaction focus flags. Derive a separate flag set for visual focus policy; do not erase interaction focus to hide focus styling. Add real pointer-focus immediately followed by Enter and Space regressions.
